start.text: It's contained. The leak is stopped, but the door is still open and the key was never changed.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. The door is open, the key never changed, and the data is already out.
A.name: Carla

B.text: What is out is out. What we can do is close the way it left, change the key, and tell the people who must know.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. The door first, then the key, then the leftover archive.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: Yes. Plainly, and after we know what left. People who trusted us deserve the truth.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Close the door, change the key, find what is left, and tell the truth.
E.name: Joshua
